pages.title: Riemann Curvature Tensor
pages.text: Carry an arrow around a small loop on a curved surface and it comes back rotated. The Riemann tensor measures exactly how much, at every point and in every direction. It is the precise mathematical meaning of curvature, and handling it feels like handling the shape of a surface directly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Differentiating the metric twice and letting it orbit a micro singularity, I tracked how parallel-transported vectors rotated. The Tensor Calculus Engine summarised the effect in a single, many-indexed tensor.
